memory_candidates.content: In this codebase's shell helpers, a function whose stdout contract is one space-separated line of key=value tokens parsed by callers as `IFS=' ' read -r a b c` plus suffix-stripping (`${c#key=}`) CANNOT be extended by appending a fourth token: `read` assigns the whole remainder of the line to the last variable, so every un-updated call site silently receives 'true nextkey=value' instead of 'true'. skill_corroborate_phase_counts (scripts/skill-base.sh) has three such call sites across two scripts plus a test-suite parser. When a new signal must cross such a boundary, prefer relocating the producing call to the consumer that needs it over widening the stdout contract -- relocation touches one site, widening touches every parser and fails silently where it is missed.
